verdict.rationale: PostHog documents capturing custom events "from any SDK". Its wizard instruments the PostHog SDKs both client-side and server-side across 26+ documented frameworks and languages. A hands-on user reports easy integration with a Swift iOS app, which corroborates mobile support. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party list of the official SDKs by language and platform (web, iOS, Android, backend languages), and dedicated mobile SDK documentation in the pack.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send events from web, mobile, and backend apps through official SDKs for the major languages and platforms

citations.quote: Custom events you capture from any SDK, each with the properties you attach to them.
